none: PAS NLM-9BCE68: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm; symbol in lower left field. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 16.6mm, Weight: 1.70gms, die axis: 6
